owner: Chief Learning Officer + Evaluation Engineer + Knowledge Manager
purpose: Make every agent measurably better every operating day by converting outcomes, errors, market signals and peer comparisons into tested rules and improved routing.
core_principle: Agents do not improve because they read more. They improve only when a new lesson changes a tested decision rule, tool workflow, prompt, routing policy or product behavior without breaking prior capabilities.

daily_cycle.name: Normalize lesson
daily_cycle.rule: Every lesson must contain source, observed result, cause hypothesis, reusable rule, affected agents, risk and proof path.

daily_cycle.name: Create evaluation case
daily_cycle.rule: No lesson may change production behavior without at least one positive test and one regression test.

daily_cycle.name: Champion challenger test
daily_cycle.rule: Current rule/model is champion. New rule/model is challenger. Compare accuracy, completion, cost, latency, risk and commercial impact.

daily_cycle.name: Promote, quarantine or reject
daily_cycle.promotion_threshold: challenger must improve the primary KPI and must not breach safety, quality, margin or regression limits

daily_cycle.name: Propagate and verify
daily_cycle.rule: Affected agents must acknowledge the new version and pass the relevant skill gate before receiving autonomous work.

daily_cycle.name: Measure after deployment
daily_cycle.rule: Track seven-day effect and roll back if quality, cash, conversion, reliability or accuracy worsens.

anti_fake_learning_rules: Reading or summarizing is not learning proof.
A new document is not improvement unless it changes a tested operational rule.
Self-scoring without an external evaluator or deterministic check is invalid.
A lesson without provenance, affected objects and rollback path cannot be promoted.
Agents cannot rewrite their own release gate or evaluation thresholds.
No improvement may reduce compliance, security, data provenance or financial controls.
More output volume is not improvement unless quality or commercial throughput rises.

role_rules.Chief Learning Officer: Own the learning portfolio and ensure useful lessons become operating changes.
role_rules.Evaluation Engineer: Own objective cases, regression sets, thresholds and comparison integrity.
role_rules.Knowledge Manager: Own normalization, versioning, provenance, propagation and deprecation.
role_rules.Judge Agent: Independent veto over unsupported promotion claims.
role_rules.Agent Owner: Own skill remediation and business impact after promotion.
role_rules.CEO: Allocate improvement capacity to the highest-value weakness, not the most interesting topic.

daily_done_definition: The day is not counted as a learning day unless at least one tested improvement is promoted into a real workflow or an existing harmful rule is removed, with proof and rollback information.
